title: Area & perimeter at home
sentences: Area measures the surface to cover; perimeter measures the boundary to surround.
A flooring project needs square units, while fencing needs length units.
Subtract gate widths from a fence boundary.
A waste allowance increases the flooring area by a stated percentage.
A 5 m by 4 m room needs flooring with a 10% allowance.
How much should you plan for?
Round purchases up to whole packs if required.
